name: The Shadowy Search Continues
summary: In Duskwood, the search for the journal’s origins leads from Madame Eva to Clerk Daltry in Darkshire. The journal came from the ruins of Sven Yorgen’s ransacked farmstead.

sections.title: Tracing the Binding
sections.body: Madame Eva discerned that the journal’s author was an outsider, but its binding came from within Darkshire. Clerk Daltry often sells blank ledgers and tomes to traveling scholars, spellcasters, and record-keepers. The search follows those local sales for a clue to the sinister trespasser in Duskwood’s groves.

sections.title: A Jittery Buyer
sections.body: Clerk Daltry remembers the sale despite the many records that pass through Darkshire’s town hall. About a month ago, a nervous traveler bought the blank book without giving a name. The furtive buyer kept glancing over his shoulder, leaving a clear impression on the clerk. The shadowy figure Sven glimpsed had walked openly among Darkshire’s citizens.

faq.q: Where did the mysterious book come from?
faq.answer: Madame Eva says the author is a stranger to Darkshire, but the book was bought in town. Clerk Daltry sells blank books and may remember who bought it.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva send you to Clerk Daltry?
faq.answer: Madame Eva discerned that the book’s binding and materials came from a local purchase. Clerk Daltry sells blank ledgers and journals to locals and traveling scholars.

faq.q: What does Clerk Daltry remember about the buyer?
faq.answer: Daltry remembers a nervous, nameless traveler who bought the blank book about a month ago.

faq.q: How does this connect to Sven's farm?
faq.answer: The book was salvaged from Sven Yorgen’s destroyed farm in southern Duskwood, left behind after the murderous raid that wiped out his family.

faq.q: Where does the investigation lead next?
faq.answer: The search continues at Darkshire’s Scarlet Raven Tavern, where someone may have seen where the nervous stranger stayed or whom he spoke with.
Daltry is helping identify a buyer from his ordinary book sales. Nothing in the exchange suggests he is personally threatened.

angles.text: For the Alliance, tracing who supplied and aided the necromancers in Duskwood matters to Darkshire’s safety and justice for slaughtered frontier homesteaders.
As a rogue, you know how purchase records and a merchant’s memory can help track a nervous target through town.
